purpose: Worldwide discovery registry for internet live channels and legal film/series metadata. Every external record is a candidate until source, availability, and rights are checked.

sources.name: IPTV-org structured worldwide channel catalogue
sources.notes: Worldwide structured channel metadata. Community stream references are not proof of permission, free access, or uptime. The importer keeps candidate/not_reviewed status.

sources.name: IPTV-org public M3U playlists
sources.notes: Community-maintained playlist discovery source. Do not assume stream reachability means authorized redistribution.

sources.name: YouTube live broadcasts
sources.playback: Open the official YouTube watch page or approved official player integration; do not extract or rehost YouTube media streams.
sources.notes: Search results depend on query, quota, language, and region; they are not a complete inventory of every worldwide YouTube live channel.

sources.name: Official broadcaster live websites
sources.playback: Use official embed/player links where permitted; otherwise open the broadcaster website.
sources.notes: No universal index covers every broadcaster website. Add entries by country with the official domain and source attribution; never scrape protected players or bypass access controls.

sources.name: The Movie Database movie and TV metadata
sources.notes: Metadata, titles, descriptions, posters, and discovery only. TMDB metadata does not provide streaming rights or playback. Follow attribution and licensing requirements; commercial use requires separate review.

sources.name: Internet Archive media discovery
sources.notes: Searchable public collection metadata. Review the rights/usage information for each item; do not treat an Archive listing as automatic public-domain clearance.

sources.name: Pluto TV
sources.notes: Availability and playback are controlled by the service and may vary by country/device. Do not extract or rehost streams.

sources.name: Rakuten TV Live / Free
sources.notes: Availability varies by country and device. Use official service playback.

sources.name: Samsung TV Plus
sources.notes: Device and regional restrictions apply. Do not extract or rehost streams.

sources.name: Doubo Public Channel Directory
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 for link selection/index; credit Doubo Public Channel Directory
sources.notes: The publisher says each entry is served from the broadcaster's own domain or an allowlisted broadcast-grade CDN/official free platform, excludes paid/blocked/takedown entries, and checks the first media segment daily. Technical checks and the directory's link-selection license do not grant rights to the channel's underlying content. RS TV downloads the M3U on demand and applies its own HTTPS parser.

sources.name: Free-TV/IPTV curated playlist
sources.license: Repository does not state a playlist data license in its README; links only, attribution retained
sources.notes: Maintainers describe a quality-over-quantity list, one URL per channel and channels officially offered free in at least one market; some streams can be geo-restricted or unavailable.

sources.name: FreeCastHub public IPTV
sources.notes: Small supplementary collection grouped by news, sports, weather and education. Maintainer rights claims are not independent proof; every channel still needs review.

rules: Do not mark a channel, film, or episode rights-cleared solely because a page or stream is publicly reachable.
Do not include paid, encrypted, DRM-protected, leaked, or unauthorized streams.
Do not scrape, extract, proxy, or rehost streams from official platforms without written permission.
Open YouTube and restricted broadcaster content through official playback routes.
Keep metadata discovery separate from a playable video source.
Preserve source attribution, country/region availability, and review timestamps.
Treat all external URLs and metadata as untrusted input.
The app may offer source M3U playlists for user-initiated download. Each download replaces the active local playlist; only HTTPS stream entries are imported.

reliability_policy.principle: Never promise zero buffering. Reliability is measured per source and can change without notice.

grades.A: Official broadcaster or authorized CDN; repeated successful tests from multiple networks/regions.
grades.B: Known broadcaster-origin stream; repeated tests, but limited coverage.
grades.C: Community-submitted public stream; intermittent or insufficient test history. Hidden from the default approved catalogue.
grades.rejected: Dead, unstable, unauthorized, encrypted without entitlement, or rights unclear.

product_rules: Only rights-reviewed and technically approved internet channels appear in the default playable catalogue.
Prefer official broadcaster/CDN sources over third-party relays.
Show source, last checked time, and reliability grade.
Hide stale or repeatedly failing streams from the default catalogue.
Do not use successful technical playback checks as evidence of copyright permission.

official_live_destinations.name: Euronews Live
official_live_destinations.playback: Official broadcaster website; regional availability may vary.

official_live_destinations.name: NASA+
official_live_destinations.playback: Official free NASA streaming service; use its own player.
